query: In at most 900 words with official primary URLs, verify three general Composer library release choices: (1) PHP/framework compatibility matrix with minimum and current dependency solutions, real hosted CI job/run SHA, lockfile install versus update, check-platform-reqs and no ignore-platform-reqs; distinguish supported declaration from executed evidence. (2) Independent empty install and populated PostgreSQL migration upgrade using immutable released baseline, preflight incompatibility refusal before any mutation, forward recovery versus destructive rollback; backup testing limitations. (3) Optional private authorization adapter, separate public no-credential dependency graph and exact authorized private source ref install; default-deny consumer-policy ownership and real positive/negative checks. Give alternatives and failure modes. Use Composer, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL, Laravel official docs and OWASP, no private project analysis.

content.text:
"Claim","Required evidence","What it proves"
"Supported PHP / Laravel ranges","composer.json constraints, e.g. ""php"": ""^8.2"" and ""illuminate/contracts"": ""^10.0 \|\| ^11.0 \|\| ^12.0""","Solver declaration, not runtime proof"
"Minimum solution","A dedicated CI job using lowest allowed versions, e.g. composer update --prefer-lowest --prefer-stable under each intended PHP/framework lane","Lowest satisfiable dependency set actually installs and tests"
"Current solution","A dedicated CI job using normal resolution, e.g. composer update --prefer-stable","Current compatible releases actually install and test"
"Reproducible release installation","Commit composer.lock; CI/release builds use composer install","The precise dependency graph tested is reinstalled"
